AT&T adds Gemini AI to its security system, letting users ask video questions instantly.

• AT&T’s Connected Life now includes Gemini-powered video queries.
• Only $29.99-a-month plan gets daily AI summaries and package ID.

Our read: Expect smarter alerts and AI-driven home monitoring on your AT&T plan.

Your take: Will you let AI watch your front door? Tell us in the comments.

items.text:
Amazon adds decision models to Bedrock AgentCore, boosting AI safety compliance.

• Amazon introduced AgentCore Evaluations that score AI agents using calibrated decision-model probabilities.
• The feature lets users connect external models like Jev and Strands Decider 2B for automated policy scoring.

Your take: Will you trust AI agents with automated scores? Tell us in the comments.
